protocol: Unmodified benchmarks/run.sh, perf_sweep.sh and bench_context.py; one client and one server per arm.
aggregation: Decode is the median of four retained requests. Prefill and TTFT use the first retained request; one warm-up per input length is excluded.
output_policy: Greedy generation, thinking disabled, output cap 256 tokens with EOS honored. Complete output equivalence was not checked by the HTTP client.

minicpm.chunk: auto, actual size recorded in server logs

deepseek.device_map: auto with independently movable routed/shared gate_up and down groups
